general_concerns.title: Overlay Fact Sheet (English)
general_concerns.note: The primary community reference on web accessibility overlays, maintained by accessibility practitioners and endorsed by signatories.

general_concerns.title: Overlay Fact Sheet: fitness for compliance
general_concerns.note: Explains why an overlay can improve a few provisions but cannot achieve full conformance with WCAG or laws that require it.

general_concerns.title: Overlay Fact Sheet: automated repair limits
general_concerns.note: Documents unreliable automated repair of text alternatives, form labels and errors, focus control, keyboard access, and modern component interfaces.

general_concerns.title: Overlay Fact Sheet: privacy of personal data
general_concerns.note: Describes how overlays can expose disability status and persist settings across sites without informed consent, creating privacy and consent risk.

general_concerns.title: Overlay Fact Sheet: in their own words
general_concerns.note: First-person accounts from disabled users describing overlays interfering with assistive technology and making sites harder to use.

general_concerns.title: Illinois DOIT: Accessibility overlays
general_concerns.note: Government guidance on the limits of overlay products and the need for structural remediation.

general_concerns.title: FTC: accessiBe final order (provider example)
general_concerns.note: In 2025 the FTC approved a final order requiring accessiBe to pay $1 million over deceptive claims that its AI product could make websites compliant with accessibility guidelines. This is one example of a provider-specific action, not a finding about any site listed here.

general_concerns.title: Adrian Roselli: overlay posts
general_concerns.note: A long-running archive of technical and legal commentary on specific overlay vendors. Individual posts are the author's analysis and opinion.

concerns.title: FTC final order requiring accessiBe to pay $1 million
concerns.note: The FTC approved a final order over deceptive claims that its AI product could make websites compliant with accessibility guidelines.
